description: Wait until an element reaches a state: attached, visible, hidden, or detached.

state.description: State to wait for: present in the DOM, present and visible, invisible or absent, or absent

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds

name: page_waitForElement
